title: Virat Kohli vs Sachin Tendulkar
shortAnswer: Sachin Tendulkar holds the records: 100 international centuries, 34,357 international runs, and played for 24 years. Virat Kohli has 82 international centuries and is widely considered the best modern batsman. Tendulkar leads in records; Kohli in consistency and fitness.
verdict: Tendulkar is the record holder and cricket's God. Kohli is the greatest modern batsman with an exceptional conversion rate. Both are undisputed all-time greats.

lines.hook: One man scored a hundred international hundreds. Nobody else has reached ninety.
lines.tape: Records versus the modern machine. One built the mountain, one is still climbing.
rounds: Eighty-two is extraordinary. One hundred is a number built to never fall.
Thirty-four thousand runs. Kohli needs eight thousand more just to draw level.
Fifty-three in Tests is pure Test greatness. Forty-nine is merely excellent.
Twenty-four years at the top. Kohli has been going since 2008 and counting.
lines.verdict: Sachin takes it four-nil on numbers. Pick Kohli if chasing matters more than records.

youtubeDescription:
A head-to-head look at Virat Kohli and Sachin Tendulkar across international centuries, total runs, Test average and career length. Tendulkar's 100 hundreds and 34,357 runs set the benchmark, while Kohli's 82 centuries keep the argument alive. Here is what the numbers actually say.

Figures accurate as of October 2026. Statistics change over time — see the full, maintained comparison at https://www.aversusb.net/compare/virat-kohli-vs-sachin-tendulkar
